verdict.rationale: The evidence documents unlimited custom fields and custom pipeline stages on the built-in records. It also shows a REST API covering fixed entity types: deals, people, companies, activities, calendar entries and documents. Nothing shows a developer can define new custom object types or relationships between them. Custom fields on existing objects are an adjacent feature, not custom object modeling, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can model custom objects with fields and relationships beyond the built-in contacts, companies, and deals
